These are the live ACP streams from agentloop's `acp/testdata/golden`, copied
unchanged from agentloop commit 076691549fc326fe80597bd1e49734054f3046c5.
Each line is a session update the agent sent, and the last line is the

To refresh them, copy the files again and update the commit above. Nothing
here imports agentloop.
